items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I think Punch only got that when he left here.

ctx.x: It's too bad Chris Kelly didn't and Buddy Petey, none of those fellows made records. No, you didn't get that. Punch did and Armstrong and a lot of others. Yeah.
I think Punch only got that when he left here.
Yes, but Chicago, he made it.
